Name: Kari's Seasonal Gabriel Portraits - Adventurer's Guild Expanded
Author: kariiiii
Description:
I didn't like the way Gabriel looked so i gave him a new hairstyle, new pair of glasses and a facelift. Also got rid of his five o'clock shadow! :D Seasonal outfits from[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12254] Seasonal Outfits for Adventurer's Guild Expanded[/url][/b] included! 

To install the mod please unpack the file in the mods folder.
This is my first mod, I hope you like it! :)

Im open to suggestions for new mods so please leave me your feedback in the comments! 

[url=https://ko-fi.com/kariz][b]If you would like to support my work please visit ko-fi.com/kariz[/b]
[/url]
